name: Rope & Chain Weapon Training
description:
You are trained in the use of rope and chain weapons, a special weapon type.

Whenever you make an attack with a rope or chain weapon, you may spend any number of additional half actions before making the attack roll. On a hit, +1d damage for each half action you spent.

improvements.name: Grappling
improvements.description:
When you hit with a rope or chain weapon, you may spend a half action to attempt to restrain the target. Roll Dexterity vs Dexterity. On a win, the target is restrained. On a loss, no effect.

A restrained creature may try to break free on their turn by spending an action and rolling Strength against your original Dexterity result. If you are no longer holding the weapon, their roll is favored. Any adjacent creature can free them by spending a half action (no roll required).

While restraining a foe, you cannot attack with the restraining weapon. Instead, you may spend an action to pull them up to 1/4 your speed toward you or knock them prone.

improvements.name: Reach
improvements.description: Once per turn, you may double the reach of a rope or chain weapon for one attack, but you must spend a half action to pull the weapon back to you before you can make another attack with it.
